fold_rule: 8x8 source blocks, (column+2*row)%5; reserve each color once. Remove fit points within <=3 source pixels of any held-out point.
global_fit: OpenCV homography RANSAC, threshold3 Yale pixels, max10000, confidence0.999, seed+fold
shuffle_seed: seed+1000*page_number+fold, page order f3r/f3v/f4r/f4v; one fixed residual permutation per case
f4r_adoption: All5 spatial_median fold gates must pass; pooled p90 lower than global and shuffled controls. Then fit all414 original correspondences with seed+10000, check17x25 coarse grid orientation, and require all64 word polygons valid. No words exported as accepted if any final check fails.
scope: Previously explored pages and candidate SIFT correspondences. Hypothesis motivated by old fit-only data. Development geometry diagnostic, not independent expert registration, new manuscript samples, linguistic evidence or decipherment.
